statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour Holter monitor, CPT code 93226, was ordered
The Holter monitor was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The diagnosis codes are I25.10, I34.0, and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
